blockingFindings.description: Direct review of the current eleven renders and Astra visual review: shortening reduced the oversized panels, but sit/crouch still show angular side flaps and sharply folded trim with panels hanging below/behind the thighs. Standing side views retain dense horizontal ridges and overlapping pointed hem corners; the hem remains irregular.
Prototype geometric under-shorts upper-thigh coverage remains 68.6% neutral, 64.2% crouch and 63.8% sit. These values are diagnostic only and do not establish fit or acceptable coverage.
Avatar fit and Shape Key response, complete UVs, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release package readiness remain unverified. Keep all quality gates unchanged.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
